key_claims: Gibbons-Neff sought absolution from the wrong party: the Taliban still shelter al-Qaeda, host training camps, hunt interpreters and ex-ANSF, and run a 'gender apartheid' regime, none of which his article addresses.
The article omits 9/11 and the Taliban's harboring of al-Qaeda, framing the war as invaders vs. freedom fighters.
Most Afghans (Asia Foundation polling) supported the US presence and government and did not want the US to leave as it did.
The NYT has whitewashed the Taliban before, notably Sirajuddin Haqqani's 'What We, the Taliban, Want' op-ed; Roggio used that op-ed in legal cases to prove the Haqqanis are part of the Taliban.
Hibatullah Akhundzada's own son was a suicide bomber; Taliban commanders' claim that their fighters have no suicides reflects that culture.
US generals have never taken accountability for losing the war; the hosts expect more whitewashing around the 5th anniversary of the fall and 25th of 9/11.
